meta.notes: Weights from BRW are in Unzen (ounces, 25g each); converted to Stein (1 Stein = 40 Unzen = 1 kg) where specified. BRW prices in Silbertaler. Aventuria Armory uses TDE5 system (DP, AT/PA Mod, Reach) but English names provided.

pdf_sources_for_range_bands: tde_german_rules (DSA 4.1 Basisregelwerk.pdf): table Aventurische Schuss- und Wurfwaffen p.163; Entfernung / Reichweiteklassen erläutert p.152–155.
arsenal_kompendium (Arsenal_Kompendium.pdf): Schuss- und Wurfwaffen pp.6–7 where a weapon is absent from BRW p.163.
ranged_and_throwing.distance_class_span: distance_class_min / distance_class_max remain the inclusive Entfernungsklassen (EK) span from the same BRW table (combat grid), separate from Schritt-based Reichweiteklassen.
ranged_and_throwing.range_bands_schritt_upper_note: Per-weapon array range_bands_schritt_upper: five upper inclusive limits in Schritt, in the same order as reichweiteklassen_order (BRW p.153: Entfernung bis zum ersten Wert = sehr nah, bis zum zweiten = nah, usw.).
ranged_and_throwing.tp_plus_by_range_band_note: Per-weapon array tp_plus_by_range_band: optional-rule TP shifts from BRW column TP+ (parentheses). null means the table used an em dash (–) in that band (see weapon special rules).
ranged_and_throwing.weapons_without_schritt_bands_here: Hand crossbow (Handarmbrust) is AA-only in this dataset; it does not appear on BRW p.163 or in the Arsenal Kompendium extract used — add RA from your AA/TDE5 table if needed.

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.special: Universal sidearm. Cannot parry attacks from chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds. Can be thrown (improvised throw).
weapons.notes: Most common sidearm in Aventuria. Straight double-edged blade about one span long.

weapons.name: Dragon Tooth
weapons.special: Broad, very sturdy dwarven dagger. Cannot parry attacks from chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds. No known human-sized version.
weapons.notes: Dwarf-crafted. Non-dwarves suffer -1 AT, PA, DP.

weapons.name: Hunting Knife
weapons.special: Cannot parry attacks from chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds.
weapons.notes: Slightly curved, very sharp blade mainly for skinning animals. Sometimes has saw-back and breaker hook.

weapons.name: Long Dagger
weapons.special: Cannot parry attacks from chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds.
weapons.notes: Relatively narrow, very long dagger. Can also be used with Fencing Weapons talent.

weapons.name: Knife
weapons.special: Improvised weapon. Cannot parry attacks from chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds.
weapons.notes: Covers all non-combat balanced single-edged utility knives from half-span to one span blade length.

weapons.name: Heavy Dagger
weapons.special: Cannot parry attacks from chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, or two-handed swords/sabers.
weapons.notes: Dagger with longer and broader blade than a standard dagger. Common sidearm or decorated officer's weapon.

weapons.name: Throwing Dagger
weapons.special: Balanced for throwing. Improvised melee weapon (no grip plates). Cannot parry chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds in melee.
weapons.notes: Slightly longer and heavier than throwing knife.

weapons.name: Throwing Knife
weapons.special: Balanced for throwing. Improvised melee weapon. Cannot parry chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, or two-handed swords/sabers in melee.
weapons.notes: Without grip plates, unsuitable as serious melee weapon.

weapons.name: Basilisk-tongue
weapons.special: Sinuous blade resembling a serpent's tongue. Sanctified versions exist for Blessed Ones of Hesinde (and Nameless One). +2 DP in ambush. -1 DP vs armor PRO 2+.
weapons.notes: Popular with Hesinde clergy and assassins. Exceptional blade cuts easily through fur, cloth, flesh.

weapons.name: Borndorn
weapons.special: Special throwing dagger from the Bornland, almost a throwing dart. Stable triangular blade. Also throwable.
weapons.notes: Bedingt nahkampftauglich (limited melee suitability).

weapons.name: Hook Dagger
weapons.special: Parrying weapon (grants +1 PA bonus to primary weapon). On successful parry roll 1d6: on 1-2 opponent's AT penalized -1 next round. Botch confirmation on AT 19+ (more likely botch).
weapons.notes: Used as off-hand parrying weapon.

weapons.name: Main Gauche
weapons.special: Parrying weapon (+1 bonus to primary weapon's PA). Ignores normal -2 penalty for Deadly Thrust maneuver. -1 DP vs armor PRO 6+.
weapons.notes: Left-hand parrying dagger designed for dual-wielding with a sword or rapier.

weapons.name: Mengbilar
weapons.special: Poison weapon: target wounded by poisoned Mengbilar subtracts 1 from TOU on poison check. Breaks on confirmed botch during attack.
weapons.notes: Exotic dagger from Tulamydian region.

weapons.name: Ogre Catcher
weapons.special: Hooks extend automatically on hit; target must make Feat of Strength check to pull free. Embedded dagger inflicts 1 DP every 5 minutes. On successful parry: make Feat of Strength check or drop weapon.
weapons.notes: Cruel trapping dagger.

weapons.name: Waqqif
weapons.special: Broad curved dagger. Cannot parry chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds. Subtracts 1 PRO from armor with PRO 2 or less.
weapons.notes: In the Tulamydian region (especially among Novadis) also serves as jewelry and symbol of honor.

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.special: Narrow sword with decorative guard. Transitions between rapier, epee, and sword are fluid.
weapons.notes: Can also be used with Swords talent.

weapons.name: Epée (Degen)
weapons.special: Very narrow sword with elaborate grip. Usually single-edged with pronounced tip. Cannot parry chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, or halberds.
weapons.notes: Considered the essence of fencing weapons. Widespread in Almada and Horasian Empire.

weapons.name: Foil
weapons.special: No cutting edge, only a tip. Bell-shaped guard with sweeping parry bars. Very flexible. Cannot parry chain weapons, two-handed blunt weapons, two-handed swords/sabers, or halberds. Foils can parry only daggers, other fencing weapons, and unarmed attacks.
weapons.notes: Highly specialized fencing weapon.

weapons.name: Sword Cane
weapons.special: Concealed blade within walking cane. Identifying as weapon requires Perception check. Opponent does not receive -1 defense penalty (normal for fencing weapons).
weapons.notes: Disguised weapon popular with merchants and nobles.

weapons.name: Wolf-knife
weapons.special: When opponents have same INI, wolf-knife always strikes first. When wielded by non-elves: -1 AT, PA, DP.
weapons.notes: Elven fencing weapon. Available only to glade elves and wood elves during hero creation.

weapons.name: Cutlass
weapons.special: In cramped spaces receive only -2 to AT and PA. -1 PA vs two-handed weapons.
weapons.notes: Broad single-edged straight blade with basket guard. Typical sidearm of sailors, pirates, and naval warriors.

weapons.name: Short Sword
weapons.special: Cannot parry chain weapons or two-handed blunt weapons.
weapons.notes: Straight blade with short cross-guard. Effective weapon popular for over 2,000 years in Aventuria.

weapons.name: Kusliker Saber
weapons.special: Straight, usually sesquiedge blade with decorated narrow basket guard. Also known as 'Korbschwert'.
weapons.notes: Popular with naval warriors. Can also use Sabers talent.

weapons.name: Long Sword
weapons.special: The Aventurian longsword with straight or slightly downward-bent cross-guard.
weapons.notes: Quasi the status symbol of all fighting professions.

weapons.name: Broadsword
weapons.special: Can perform Shield-Splitter maneuver (normally not available to Swords technique). -2 PA vs Two-Handed Blunt Weapons and Two-Handed Swords.
weapons.notes: Popular in Albernia and Thorwal.

weapons.name: Saber
weapons.special: +1 DP in mounted combat. -1 DP vs armor PRO 4+.
weapons.notes: Single-edged slightly curved blade with elaborate tip. Typical cavalry sidearm.

weapons.name: Khunchomer
weapons.special: Typical Tulamydian saber that widens from the hilt, making it 'top-heavy', has no tip. Bladestorm maneuver: reduce penalty for both attacks by 1. -1 DP vs armor PRO 5+.
weapons.notes: Traditional Tulamydian weapon.

weapons.name: Amazon Saber
weapons.special: +2 DP when used while mounted. -2 PA vs Two-Handed Blunt Weapons and Two-Handed Swords.
weapons.notes: Named for the Amazon warriors. Slender single-edged sword with strongly curved blade, ideal for mounted use.

weapons.name: Barbarian Sword
weapons.special: +1 bonus on Intimidation (Threats) checks. When two opponents have same INI, barbarian sword always strikes last.
weapons.notes: Wielded by Fjarnings, Gjalsks, and Troll Peakers. Heavy, slow, effective at smashing armor and shields.

weapons.name: Nightwind
weapons.special: Two-handed use grants +2 DP instead of +1 DP. Evil reputation causes -1 CHA for Social checks when onlookers know of it.
weapons.notes: Maraskan weapon with sinister reputation.

weapons.name: Slave-death
weapons.special: +1 DP vs unarmored humanoids (PRO 0). After successful parry roll 1d6: on 6, slave-death becomes entangled and wielder suffers -1 AT next round.
weapons.notes: Found in Al'Anfa and Far South regions.

weapons.name: Seal-killer
weapons.special: +1 DP vs animals of medium and large size categories. Non-elves suffer -1 AT, PA, DP.
weapons.notes: Firn elf weapon. Only available to frinelves during hero creation.

weapons.name: Bastard Sword (Hand-and-a-Half)
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon (z). Can also be used with Two-Handed Swords talent. Versatile fighting style for one or two-handed use.
weapons.notes: Between a sword and a two-hander. Privileged weapon.

weapons.name: Tuzak Knife
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Requires minimum AGI 15 to use at full effectiveness. Below AGI 15: -1 TP per point below, -1 INI bonus, -1 PA per point below.
weapons.notes: Maraskan sword with slightly curved sesquiedge blade. Fast due to light blade.

weapons.name: Great Sword (Two-hander)
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Privileged weapon (may only be carried by recognized fighters, nobles).
weapons.notes: Classic two-hander: broad-bladed double-edged sword with long grip, quite front-heavy.

weapons.name: Andergaster
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Overlong two-handed sword with long false-edge. Despite its name, favored weapon of Almadan and Horasian double mercenaries.
weapons.notes: Privileged weapon.

weapons.name: Boron's Sickle
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Overlong curved sword with sesquiedge blade, designed for use against cavalry. Usually without cross-guard.
weapons.notes: Widespread in Almada and Aranien.

weapons.name: Double-Khunchomer
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. On critical success, confirmation roll receives +2 bonus. Cannot perform Feints.
weapons.notes: Impressive Tulamydian blade weapon, usually carried by bodyguards or harem guards for intimidation.

weapons.name: Great Slave-death
weapons.special: +1 Intimidation check bonus. +1 DP vs unarmored humanoids (PRO 0). On successful parry by opponent: roll 1d6, on 5-6 slave-death becomes stuck, -1 AT next round.
weapons.notes: Found in Al'Anfa and Far South.

weapons.name: Rondra's Crest
weapons.special: Sanctified (Rondra). Only Blessed Ones of Rondra may purchase sanctified versions. +1 bonus for Windmill maneuver. Cannot perform Quickdraw.
weapons.notes: Ceremonial weapon of Rondra's clergy. Priceless/unavailable commercially.

weapons.name: Executioner's Sword
weapons.special: Two-handed improvised weapon. After attacking, cannot parry until end of next round (can dodge instead). On critical hit or 16+ DP, enemies within reach must make Willpower check or gain Fear 1 for 5 rounds.
weapons.notes: Weapon of executioners. Available in cities.

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Attacks of halberd cannot be parried by many weapons. In cramped spaces, reduce AT/PA penalties by 2.
weapons.notes: Classic infantry weapon capable of amazing maneuvers in single combat, but requires real mastery.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Two fighters with glaives can form a wall: both within 1.5 feet, facing same direction; +1 PA. Charge with wall: lose PA bonus but +1 DP.
weapons.notes: Common infantry weapon with broad single-edged blade usually without tip.

weapons.name: Hook Spear (Gisarme)
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Can unhorse riders.
weapons.notes: Inexpensive and widespread militia weapon. Seldom decorated.

weapons.name: Partisan
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Polearm with broad thrust blade and symmetrical side blades. Can also use Spears talent.
weapons.notes: Often richly decorated as a courtly guard weapon.

weapons.name: Reaper (Storm Scythe)
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. +1 AT bonus when using Onslaught maneuver. -1 penalty on Charge maneuver.
weapons.notes: When scythe blade is mounted lengthwise rather than crosswise, creates storm scythe - typical weapon for peasant militias.

weapons.name: Pailos
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Sweep maneuver gets +1 bonus. Feint gets -1 penalty.
weapons.notes: Cyclopean weapon of great power.

weapons.name: Worm Spear
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Dwarven variant of the partisan, proportioned for Angroschim.
weapons.notes: Can also use Spears talent.

weapons.name: Warunk Hammer
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Long spike can be used as thrust weapon (Spears talent, AT -3, 1d6+5 DP). Subtracts 1 PRO from armor PRO 4+.
weapons.notes: Extremely effective multipurpose weapon with long thrust spike, flat hammer head, and straight axe blade.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. From KK 16 can be used one-handed: DP 1d6+4, TP/KK 13/5, WM 0/-5. Can be thrown (improvised).
weapons.notes: About one-and-a-half steps long with lancet-shaped thrust blade. Now mostly only used by hunters.

weapons.name: Wooden Spear
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Can also be thrown. Heavier variants with stone/horn tips add 1 TP.
weapons.notes: Simple straight spear with fire-hardened wooden tip. Typical weapon of primitive tribal societies.

weapons.name: Trident
weapons.special: Also improvised weapon. Reduces penalties for fighting in water by 2. Disarm maneuver +1 bonus. -1 DP vs armor PRO 2+.
weapons.notes: Large fish spear common on the Aventurian west coast.

weapons.name: Dshadra
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Can be used in mounted combat and for Charge. -1 penalty on Takedown. Thrown from horseback inflicts +2 DP.
weapons.notes: Tulamydian short cavalry lance. Used by Novadis both mounted and on foot or as throwing weapon.

weapons.name: Hunting Spear
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Can be thrown. From KK 15 can be used one-handed: DP 1d6+5, TP/KK 13/5, WM 0/-4. Target attempting to escape Nail Down gets -1 on Feat of Strength check.
weapons.notes: Used especially by wood elves. Has a crossbar behind the blade to prevent deep penetration.

weapons.name: Thrust Spear (Boar Spear)
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Long spear with broad blade, usually with crossbar and hand-guard. Weapon for hunting large game.

weapons.name: Throwing Spear (Javelin)
weapons.special: Balanced for throwing. Improvised melee weapon. About four spans long, good balance, iron tip with long iron bands.

weapons.name: Quarterstaff
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Takedown maneuver gets +1 bonus. Charge maneuver gets -1 penalty.
weapons.notes: About twice finger-thick, straight wooden staff about one and a half steps long, usually with iron bands at ends.

weapons.name: Mage's Staff
weapons.special: Ritual instrument and status symbol of mages. Unbreakable combat staff (see Quarterstaff). Privileged weapon.
weapons.notes: Only available to Guild Mages. Value is effectively priceless (unavailable for purchase).

weapons.name: Two-lilies
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. When making more than one PA in same round, reduce penalty by 1. Forceful Blow maneuver: -1 DP.
weapons.notes: Unusual weapon from the Grangor region: staff of about one step long with broad dagger blades and small barbs at both ends.

weapons.name: Battle-axe
weapons.notes: Generic war axe known in all Aventurian cultures in some form.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.special: Heavy two-handed blunt weapon with up to eight iron striking blades from central stem. Can not only break bones but also smash armor.

weapons.name: Cudgel
weapons.special: Stunning Blow maneuver inflicts 1d3+1 DP. Breaks on confirmed botch on AT.
weapons.notes: Club improved with added iron bands, long nails driven through, etc.

weapons.name: Club
weapons.special: Stunning Blow maneuver inflicts 1d3+1 DP. Breaks on confirmed botch on AT.
weapons.notes: The most primitive form of weapon - a somewhat balanced, roughly planed or carved branch.

weapons.name: Raven's Beak
weapons.special: Attacks with spike also inflict 1d6+4 DP. Subtract 2 PRO from armor PRO 6+. Mounted warriors gain +1 DP. On confirmed botch receive 1 level of Stupor.
weapons.notes: Typical light cavalry hammer with blunt and pointed sides.

weapons.name: Brabak Cudgel
weapons.special: Special form of mace with multiple spines from heavy ball. Can also be used to stab with central spine (Daggers talent, AT -3): 1d6+4 DP; following own parade also -3. On confirmed botch: 1 level Stupor.
weapons.notes: Usually decorated with a face, giving the weapon its name.

weapons.name: Molokdeshnaja
weapons.special: +1 bonus to Intimidation (Threats) checks. When wielding two Molokdeshnajas at once: -1 penalty to all AT and PA.
weapons.notes: Bornland weapon.

weapons.name: Orc-nose (Orknase)
weapons.special: Shield Splitter maneuver inflicts +4 DP. -1 additional penalty when parrying daggers and fencing weapons. Two-handed weapon.
weapons.notes: Thorwaler axe with long downward-drawn ('bearded') blade. Can be used one-handed from KK 14 with Axes/Maces talent: TP/KK 13/3.

weapons.name: Lindworm Slayer
weapons.special: Dwarven hand axe with extremely 'long-bearded' blade. Very heavy for its small size.

weapons.name: Sun-scepter
weapons.special: Sanctified (Praios). Only Blessed Ones of Praios may purchase. +1 PA during day. +1 DP vs beings with AE. -1 AT during night. -1 DP vs armor PRO 4+.
weapons.notes: Ceremonial weapon of Praios clergy.

weapons.name: Wyvern-beater
weapons.special: Shield-Splitter maneuver +4 DP. -1 AT vs large and huge creatures. Non-dwarves: -1 AT, PA, DP.
weapons.notes: Dwarven weapon. Only available to dwarven cultures during hero creation.

weapons.name: Rock-cleaver
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. +1 Hammer Blow bonus. Shatter maneuver: roll 2d6, use better die. Non-dwarves: -2 AT, PA, DP. Botch on Forceful Blow/Hammer Blow: weapon stuck.
weapons.notes: Dwarven double-bladed axe proportioned for Angroschim.

weapons.name: War Hammer
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Can be used one-handed from KK 18 with Axes/Maces talent: TP/KK 15/3.
weapons.notes: Many variants exist. Strike face sometimes spiked to pierce armor.

weapons.name: Barbarian Battle-axe
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Requires minimum STR 15. On critical success or 14+ DP: all enemies within reach must make Willpower check (-1) or gain Fear 1 for 5 rounds. Confirmed botch: 1 level Stupor to wielder.
weapons.notes: Massive double-bladed axe used mainly in northern Aventuria (Thorwalers, Fjarnings, Gjalsks).

weapons.name: Dwarf Cudgel
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. In cramped spaces: only -2 AT/PA penalty. Forceful Blow II/III: +1 DP. Non-dwarves: -2 AT, PA, DP. Feint: additional -1 penalty.
weapons.notes: Dwarven war hammer proportioned for Angroschim.
weapons.source: BRW p. 161 / AA p. 66 / AK p. 89

weapons.name: Morningstar
weapons.special: Chain weapon: can strike around shield edges (shield PA bonus not counted). Defending against morningstar is -2 for all weapons that can parry it. Botch already on AT/PA 19 or 20; control roll +2 harder.
weapons.notes: Often spike-studded ball on short chain attached to wooden haft.

weapons.name: Ogre Swatter
weapons.special: Two-ball morningstar. Can strike around shield edges. Defending is -3 (not -2). Requires min STR 15. On confirmed botch: 1 level Stupor and 2 DP to wielder.

weapons.name: Ox-herd
weapons.special: Two-handed weapon. Three-ball morningstar. Can strike around shield edges. Defending is -3 instead of -2. Requires min STR 16. Hammer Blow: roll 2d6, use higher die. Botch (confirmed or not): 1 level Stupor; confirmed: 4 DP.
weapons.notes: Extremely heavy chain weapon.

weapons.name: Fist/Kick/Head Butt
weapons.special: WM modifiers apply only when fighting armed opponents. Unarmed strike inflicts TP(A) - aggravated damage.
weapons.notes: Unarmed combat.

weapons.name: Brass Knuckles
weapons.notes: Available in cities.

weapons.name: Orchid
weapons.special: No damage when armed enemy parries orchid (normal for Brawling). Breaks on confirmed botch.
weapons.notes: Special brawling weapon. Available in cities.

weapons.name: Spiked Vambrace
weapons.special: Parrying Weapon (+1 PA to primary weapon). Counts as armed (no brawling penalties vs armed opponent). Cannot perform Grapple or grappling-based maneuvers. -2 penalty to Stealth (Conceal Item) checks.
weapons.notes: Worn on the arm. Also available as Panzerarm (heavier version at 140 ST).

weapons.name: Short Bow
weapons.special: Reload: 2 actions. Typical Aventurian hunting bow of four to six spans bow length.
weapons.notes: Also shoots from horseback.

weapons.name: Long Bow
weapons.special: Reload: 4 actions. Requires min STR 15 to use effectively; below that all targets count one class further and -2 DP. Cannot be used from horseback.
weapons.notes: Body-length bow of ash or yew. Primarily in northern Middenrealm, Nostria, and Andergast.

weapons.name: Composite Bow
weapons.special: Reload: 3 actions. Requires min STR 15; below that all targets count one class further and -2 DP. Cannot be used from horseback. Subtract 1 from range penalties.
weapons.notes: Made from multiple materials (horn, sinew, wood) for increased draw strength.

weapons.name: War Bow
weapons.special: Reload: 4 actions. Requires min STR 16 to use effectively; below that all targets count one class further and -2 DP. Cannot be used from horseback.
weapons.notes: Extremely strong and still quite short bow.

weapons.name: Elf Bow
weapons.special: Reload: 3 actions. Cannot be used from horseback. +1 bonus for Precise Shot. Non-elves: -2 RC penalty. Not purchasable - only found in elven hands.
weapons.notes: Slightly shorter than longbow. Demonstrates elven craftsmanship. Typically not for sale.

weapons.name: Light Crossbow
weapons.special: Reload: 15 actions. Can be cocked with a 'goat's foot'. If STR below 12 doubling reload time.
weapons.notes: Popular as decorated hunting weapon and basic militia weapon.

weapons.name: Heavy Crossbow
weapons.special: Reload: 30 actions. Cocked with a winch. After field march, check if fouled (19-20 on d20): needs 3 rounds to clean, else +3 AT penalty and botch on 19-20.
weapons.notes: Heavy crossbow with extreme long range and precision.

weapons.name: Iron Forest Crossbow
weapons.special: Reload: 3 actions per shot (magazine holds 10 bolts); 20 actions to change magazine. +3 bonus for Aiming (max +4). After field march: check fouling.
weapons.notes: Magazine crossbow for rapid fire.

weapons.name: Balestrina
weapons.special: Reload: 2 actions. Fires bullets instead of bolts. Beloved by nobility for bird hunting. Botch roll of 20 jams weapon (2 actions to clear).
weapons.notes: Small crossbow shooting lead or stone balls.
weapons.source: BRW p. 163 / AA p. 95 / AK p. 41

weapons.name: Hand Crossbow
weapons.special: Reload: 3 actions. At short range +1 DP. At far range -1 DP.
weapons.notes: Compact one-handed crossbow.

weapons.name: Throwing Axe
weapons.special: Target must be at least 5 steps away. Can also be used as improvised melee weapon. Cannot parry chain weapons or two-handed blunt weapons in melee.
weapons.notes: Small throwing axes usually made entirely of metal, sharpened on all sides except the handle.

weapons.name: Cut-tooth (Schneidzahn)
weapons.special: Target must be at least 5 steps away. Thorwaler rune-ornamented throwing axe with complicated flight path. AT check is +1 harder. Powerful Throw: subtract 1 from damage threshold.
weapons.notes: AT probe erschwert um 1.

weapons.name: Throwing Club
weapons.special: Targets taking 6+ DP must succeed at Body Control (Balance) check (-1 per DP above 6) or become prone. -2 DP vs armor PRO 4+.

weapons.name: Throwing Disc/Ring/Star
weapons.special: Discs: +1 RC. Rings: +1 DP vs unarmored humanoids. Stars: on 6+ DP become embedded; target -1 AT, PA, DO, RC until end of next round. Botch confirmation on 19+.
weapons.notes: Sharpened or serrated metal discs.

weapons.name: Discus
weapons.special: Reload: 2 actions.
weapons.notes: Also combat discus (Kampfdiskus) variant at 60 ST with better range and DP.

weapons.name: Blowpipe
weapons.special: Reload: 2 actions. If a poisoned blowdart inflicts at least 1 DP, target is poisoned.
weapons.notes: Very low direct damage but excellent for delivering poisons.

weapons.name: Buckler
weapons.special: Parrying weapon (+1 PA bonus to primary weapon). AT penalty applies only when attacking with shield. Cannot parry projectiles. Cannot parry two-handed blunt weapons or two-handed swords/sabers.
weapons.notes: Small fist shield of wood and/or leather, usually just a half-sphere with narrow rim.

weapons.name: Large (Full Metal) Buckler
weapons.special: Parrying weapon. Flat steel dome with hand-wide rim. Cannot parry two-handed blunt weapons.
weapons.notes: Steel fist shield, lined inside with leather or felt.

weapons.name: Wooden Shield
weapons.special: Large shield. Chain weapons can bypass shield (PA bonus from shield not counted).
weapons.notes: Usually heraldic-form shield of cross-glued wooden boards, leather-covered edges and outer face.

weapons.name: Reinforced Wooden Shield
weapons.special: Large shield. Iron reinforcements on edges, iron bands or rivets on the outer striking face.
weapons.notes: Round, octagonal, or heraldic form with iron reinforcements.

weapons.name: Leather Shield
weapons.special: Small shield. +1 PA bonus during Defensive Posture. Shield Smash inflicts only 1 DP.
weapons.notes: Round wooden frame covered with multiple layers of tough leather. Common among riding peoples (Orks, Novadis).

weapons.name: Large Leather Shield
weapons.special: Large shield. Larger, usually oval or teardrop-shaped, especially designed for cavalry use.

weapons.name: Thorwaler Shield
weapons.special: Medium shield. When combined with main weapon for Charge: main weapon +1 DP. When used while mounted: only simple shield bonus.
weapons.notes: Large round wooden shield with iron edges and usually iron boss in center. Painted with ornaments in Thorwaler fashion.

weapons.name: Great Shield (Cavalry Shield)
weapons.special: Large shield. -1 AT penalty to primary weapon additionally. Opponent without great shield always strikes first when same INI. Bearer -1 MOV. When parrying arrows/bolts: double PA bonus +1.
weapons.notes: Long teardrop-shaped cavalry shield of cross-glued layers of wood and leather.
